_comment: 相談ページ（soudan_lecture）の 絵の 作り直し（2026-10-27）。1回目（hourensou_okuda.json ほか）は 字も 印も 入れず、表情も おだやかで、何の 絵か 分からなかった（tomy さん「絵の中に文字、アイコンを入れないことで絵が何を伝えたいのか理解できない」「表情なども極端にした方がわかりやすい」）。旧アプリの スライドの 骨（ラベル・？・電球・ERROR の 画面）を 戻し、気持ちを 大げさに 描く。cases_a / cases_b / abc は 1枚に 何コマか 描かせて、あとで コマごとに 切り分ける（カード 1枚に 絵 1枚）。
style: Warm modern anime illustration, like a friendly Japanese educational manga — clean confident black linework, flat cel shading, bright natural daylight, soft pastel palette of sky blue, cream and coral, rounded friendly shapes. A tidy contemporary Japanese software office with real desks, chairs, windows, plants, mugs and laptops. People are drawn as real human beings with natural proportions and exactly five fingers on each hand. This is a TEACHING picture, not a mood picture: a student who can hardly read Japanese must understand the message from the picture alone. EMOTIONS ARE BIG AND OBVIOUS, like a Japanese comedy manga — exaggerated faces and whole-body poses that read from across the room. Troubled people clutch their heads, droop their shoulders, sweat big comic sweat drops, and have wavy worried mouths and teary or swirling eyes. Relieved and happy people beam with huge open smiles and sparkling eyes, raise a fist or give a thumbs-up, with little sparkles around them. Puzzled people tilt their heads under a big question mark. Manga symbols are welcome and carry the message: big question marks, exclamation marks, sweat drops, lightbulbs, sparkles, gloomy rain clouds, motion lines, check marks. Two different people appear in these pictures and they must never look alike. OKUDA is the senior engineer shown in the attached character sheet: a Japanese man in his mid twenties, wavy messy black hair with volume, black rectangular thick-rimmed glasses, a dark green pullover hoodie. THE NEW ENGINEER is a DIFFERENT and YOUNGER man: a Southeast Asian man in his early twenties, warm brown skin, short cropped black hair, NO GLASSES, a plain cream polo shirt and dark grey trousers. Only Okuda wears glasses and a green hoodie. Never give the two men the same face, hair, glasses or clothes.
noText: Lettering — read this part carefully. The picture contains ONLY the words listed above, and no other writing at all. Print each Japanese word LARGE and horizontally in a bold rounded gothic Japanese font, with generous space around it — either on a soft cream label with a rounded border, or inside a white speech balloon whose tail clearly points at the person who says it. Directly above every kanji, print its reading in small hiragana (furigana), centred over that kanji, clearly separated from it, at about 45% of the kanji height, so that the kanji and the furigana both stay sharp. Words written only in hiragana or katakana take no furigana, and Latin letters and numbers take no furigana either. The readings in round brackets are for you only — never print the brackets or the reading in the brackets as text. Spell every character exactly as given. Screens, papers and whiteboards show only soft abstract shapes apart from the listed words. No other letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere in the picture.
negative: Never: photo-realistic rendering, harsh shadows, extra or merged fingers, distorted hands, horror or a scary dark mood, real grief, violence, watermarks, real company logos or brand marks of any kind (no fruit logo on laptops, no chat-app logos), national flags, country outlines, maps with borders, tiny cluttered text, paragraphs of text, 3D render, flat vector icon art, pictograms floating on an empty background, robots, mascots.

scenes.title: 相談すると 解決する
scenes.where: content/articles/soudan_lecture.json「日本の IT会社では…相談します」の 下
scenes.scene: THE ONE IDEA THIS PICTURE MUST MAKE OBVIOUS: when you consult a senior, the problem gets solved together. Wide medium two-shot at Okuda's desk. The new engineer stands holding his open laptop towards the viewer; the screen now shows one big green check mark. He is overjoyed — huge open smile, sparkling eyes, little sparkles around his head, his free hand in a happy fist. Okuda sits beside him, turned towards him, grinning and giving a big thumbs-up. A white speech balloon from the new engineer says the first word below; a white speech balloon from Okuda says the second word. Warm daylight, plants, mugs.

scenes.title: 表紙：報連相の まんなかの 相談
scenes.scene: THE ONE IDEA THIS PICTURE MUST MAKE OBVIOUS: this page is about 相談 (consulting), one of the three parts of 報連相 together with 連絡 and 報告. This picture is shown small, so keep it bold and simple. In the centre, a LARGE round cream badge with a rounded border carries the big label 相談. Inside and in front of that badge, waist-up: the new engineer, sweating with a big question mark over his head, holds his laptop showing a red error screen and turns hopefully to Okuda, who leans in with a wide welcoming smile and an open hand. In the top-left corner a much SMALLER round cream badge carries the label 連絡, and in the top-right corner a SMALLER round cream badge carries the label 報告; thin soft arrows link both small badges to the big centre badge. The office is softly blurred behind them.

scenes.title: どう しますか ①：一人で 考える
scenes.where: content/articles/soudan_lecture.json「エラーが 出た とき、どう しますか」の カード 1枚目
scenes.scene: THE ONE IDEA THIS PICTURE MUST MAKE OBVIOUS: he tries to solve the error ALONE, just by thinking. Close medium shot. The new engineer sits alone at his desk, chin on his fist, frowning hard at his laptop, whose screen shows a big red warning band with the English word ERROR. A big thought cloud above him holds a tangled scribble and a large question mark; one sweat drop on his temple. Nobody else nearby. A cream label across the top of the picture carries the words below.
text: 一人で 考える（ひとりで かんがえる）

scenes.title: どう しますか ②：友だちに 聞く
scenes.where: content/articles/soudan_lecture.json「エラーが 出た とき、どう しますか」の カード 2枚目
scenes.scene: THE ONE IDEA THIS PICTURE MUST MAKE OBVIOUS: he asks a FRIEND sitting next to him. Close medium two-shot. The new engineer rolls his chair to the next desk and points at his laptop, asking with raised eyebrows and an open mouth; a big question mark floats above him. His friend is a young Japanese woman engineer of the same age with a short bob haircut and a mustard-yellow cardigan, leaning in to look at the same laptop, curious. A cream label across the top of the picture carries the words below. Okuda is NOT in this picture.
text: 友だちに 聞く（ともだちに きく）

scenes.title: どう しますか ③：インターネットで 調べる
scenes.where: content/articles/soudan_lecture.json「エラーが 出た とき、どう しますか」の カード 3枚目
scenes.scene: THE ONE IDEA THIS PICTURE MUST MAKE OBVIOUS: he SEARCHES ON THE INTERNET. Close medium shot. The new engineer leans towards a large monitor, eyes wide and focused, one hand on the mouse. The monitor shows a web browser with one very large search box and a big magnifying-glass button, and below it a few result rows drawn as soft grey bars. A cream label across the top of the picture carries the words below. Nobody else in the picture.
text: インターネットで 調べる（しらべる）

scenes.title: 一人で 悩む と チームで 考える
scenes.where: content/articles/soudan_lecture.json の ポイント枠「ITの 仕事は チームで します」の 下
scenes.scene: THE ONE IDEA THIS PICTURE MUST MAKE OBVIOUS: struggling ALONE is slow and painful, thinking as a TEAM is fast and bright. One wide picture split into two equal halves by a straight vertical white line. LEFT HALF: a dim, gloomy office at night with a grey rain cloud drawn over the desk. The new engineer sits alone, both hands clutching his head, comic tears and sweat drops, a wavy miserable mouth; his laptop shows a red warning band with the English word ERROR, crumpled paper balls everywhere, a wall clock showing very late. Across the top of the left half a cream label carries the first two words below. RIGHT HALF: a bright sunny office. The new engineer, Okuda and a young woman colleague with a short bob and a mustard-yellow cardigan gather around one monitor that shows a big green check mark; all three laugh with huge smiles, lightbulbs and sparkles above them. Across the top of the right half a cream label carries the last two words below.
text: 一人で 悩む（ひとりで なやむ）
チームで 考える（かんがえる）

scenes.title: 相談する ばめん ①〜④（4コマ。あとで 切り分ける）
scenes.where: content/articles/soudan_lecture.json「ITで 相談する ばめん」の カード 1〜4枚目（cases_1〜cases_4 に 切る）
scenes.scene: THE ONE IDEA THIS PICTURE MUST MAKE OBVIOUS: four different moments when the new engineer is stuck and needs to consult. Layout: a two-by-two grid of FOUR EQUAL panels separated by straight, thin, pure white gutters of the same width, with a thin white margin around the outside; each panel is its own little scene and no panel has a title or number. The new engineer is in every panel with a big troubled expression. TOP-LEFT: at his desk, his monitor shows a big red warning band with the English word ERROR; he clutches his head, big question mark, sweat drops. TOP-RIGHT: he holds up a tablet showing two large cards, one marked with the letter A and one marked with the letter B, and looks from one to the other with a torn, worried face and swirling eyes. BOTTOM-LEFT: he holds a printed specification sheet in one hand and scratches his head, staring at his monitor where a number is shown; two thought balloons above him carry the two Japanese questions listed below. BOTTOM-RIGHT: he slumps at his desk, chin on the desk, bored and exhausted, watching a progress bar that barely moves on his monitor, with a small snail drawn next to the bar and the English word SLOW in red.

scenes.title: 相談する ばめん ⑤〜⑧（4コマ。あとで 切り分ける）
scenes.where: content/articles/soudan_lecture.json「ITで 相談する ばめん」の カード 5〜8枚目（cases_5〜cases_8 に 切る）
scenes.scene: THE ONE IDEA THIS PICTURE MUST MAKE OBVIOUS: four more moments when the new engineer is stuck and needs to consult. Layout: a two-by-two grid of FOUR EQUAL panels separated by straight, thin, pure white gutters of the same width, with a thin white margin around the outside; each panel is its own little scene and no panel has a title or number. The new engineer is in every panel with a big troubled expression. TOP-LEFT: his monitor shows two blocks of code crashing into each other with a lightning bolt between them and a red band with the English word CONFLICT; he throws both hands up in panic, big sweat drops, an exclamation mark. TOP-RIGHT: his monitor shows a dark terminal window with a big red cross and the English word Docker; a thought cloud above him holds a wrench and gears; he droops, exhausted, with a sweat drop. BOTTOM-LEFT: he holds up a smartphone whose tiny screen shows a cramped, broken layout with overlapping boxes, next to his monitor showing a wide neat web page; he looks at the phone with a confused, tilted head and a big question mark. BOTTOM-RIGHT: he stands at a whiteboard with an empty checklist of unticked boxes and a very large question mark drawn on it, marker in hand, scratching his head, lost; a cream label on the whiteboard carries the Japanese word listed below.

scenes.title: 30分ルールの A・B・C（3コマ。あとで 切り分けて 動画の 表紙に する）
scenes.where: content/articles/soudan_lecture.json「ポイント①：30分ルール」の A・B・C の カード（動画の 表紙。abc_a / abc_b / abc_c に 切る）
scenes.scene: THE ONE IDEA THIS PICTURE MUST MAKE OBVIOUS: three different timings for asking for help, A, B and C. Layout: THREE EQUAL TALL vertical panels side by side, separated by straight, thin, pure white gutters of the same width, with a thin white margin around the outside. At the top of each panel a round cream badge carries one big letter: A, B and C. Do NOT put any furigana or reading above the letters A, B and C. The new engineer is in every panel. PANEL A: a dim office late at night; he sits alone, slumped, dark circles under his eyes, comic tears and big sweat drops, surrounded by crumpled paper balls; his laptop shows a red warning band; a wall calendar behind him has three days crossed out with big red X marks; a grey rain cloud hangs over his head. PANEL B: a bright office; a big round wall clock has the right half of its face, from 12 down to 6, shaded light blue, showing that thirty minutes have passed; he calmly raises one hand and holds his notebook, walking towards Okuda, who turns his chair towards him with a kind smile. PANEL C: a bright office; with fast motion lines he dashes over to Okuda the very moment an error appears, his laptop open in his arms, the coffee on his own desk still steaming and untouched; Okuda, busy on a phone call with a stack of papers, looks startled, with an exclamation mark and a sweat drop.

scenes.title: ポイント②：「何を したか」を 伝える（❌と ⭕）
scenes.scene: THE ONE IDEA THIS PICTURE MUST MAKE OBVIOUS: saying only “I don't understand” is bad; saying what you already checked is good. One wide picture split into two equal halves by a straight vertical white line. In the top-left corner of the LEFT half, a big red cross mark (✕) in a white circle; in the top-left corner of the RIGHT half, a big green circle mark (◯) in a white circle. LEFT HALF: the new engineer stands empty-handed next to Okuda's desk, shrugging with both palms up, a blank lost face, and a white speech balloon carrying the first words below. Okuda looks back at him completely puzzled, head tilted, a huge question mark and a sweat drop above his head. RIGHT HALF: the new engineer points confidently at his open notebook, where a small magnifying glass, an open book and a code window are drawn; a white speech balloon carries the second words below. Okuda nods with a bright smile and a lightbulb above his head; his own small white speech balloon carries the third word below.
text: ◯◯を 調べました（しらべました）

scenes.title: ポイント③：自分の アイデアを 持つ
scenes.scene: THE ONE IDEA THIS PICTURE MUST MAKE OBVIOUS: he brings his OWN idea and asks the senior what he thinks of it. Wide medium two-shot at Okuda's desk. The new engineer holds up a tablet showing two large cards, one marked with the letter A and one with the letter B; he points firmly at card A with a confident smile, and a bright lightbulb shines above his head. A white speech balloon from him carries the first words below. Okuda, chin on his hand, looks at the tablet and smiles, impressed, with sparkles; his white speech balloon carries the second words below.
text: 私は Aだと 思うのですが、どうでしょうか（わたしは… おもうのですが）

scenes.title: よく 使う 日本語 1：都合を 伺う
scenes.where: content/articles/soudan_lecture.json「相談で よく 使う 日本語」の カード 1枚目
scenes.scene: THE ONE IDEA THIS PICTURE MUST MAKE OBVIOUS: before consulting, he first asks the senior if he has time now. Medium two-shot. Okuda is typing at his desk; the new engineer has walked up beside him, bows slightly with one hand raised politely, a careful, hopeful face. A white speech balloon from the new engineer carries the words below. Okuda looks up from his keyboard with a friendly face.
text: 今、お時間 よろしいでしょうか（いま、おじかん）

scenes.title: よく 使う 日本語 2：用件を 伝える
scenes.where: content/articles/soudan_lecture.json「相談で よく 使う 日本語」の カード 2枚目
scenes.scene: THE ONE IDEA THIS PICTURE MUST MAKE OBVIOUS: he says first what the talk is about. Medium two-shot. Okuda has turned his chair towards the new engineer and listens. The new engineer holds his laptop and points at it with a serious, clear face; a white speech balloon from him carries the words below.
text: 相談が あります（そうだん）

scenes.title: よく 使う 日本語 3：状況と 依頼
scenes.where: content/articles/soudan_lecture.json「相談で よく 使う 日本語」の カード 3枚目
scenes.scene: THE ONE IDEA THIS PICTURE MUST MAKE OBVIOUS: he tells what he already checked, and then asks for help. Medium two-shot. The new engineer holds up his notebook, open to a short checklist with two ticked boxes and a small magnifying glass drawn beside it, and has a worried but honest face with a sweat drop. A white speech balloon from him carries the words below. Okuda leans in to look, attentive and serious.
text: 調べましたが、わかりませんでした（しらべましたが）

scenes.title: よく 使う 日本語 4：意見の 提案
scenes.where: content/articles/soudan_lecture.json「相談で よく 使う 日本語」の カード 4枚目
scenes.scene: THE ONE IDEA THIS PICTURE MUST MAKE OBVIOUS: he proposes his own idea. Medium two-shot in front of a small whiteboard that shows two boxes, one marked with the letter A and one with the letter B. The new engineer points at box A with a confident smile; a bright lightbulb shines above his head; a white speech balloon from him carries the words below. Okuda crosses his arms and nods with an impressed smile.
text: 私は Aが いいと 思います（わたしは… おもいます）
